name: torch_mechanics
title: Mixed-precision CIFAR trainer with a tabular baseline beside it
origin: written alongside ANA-8 / ANA-9 to exercise MLV207, MLV208, MLV209, MLV502, MLV803, MLV114, MLV106, MLV305 and MLV306 (Sprint 4)
tunedWhy: the rules were developed against this project, so its numbers are a ceiling, not a measurement - it is excluded from the unseen headline in ACCURACY.md
note: No `graph` block: added for its findings, not for a hand-drawn diagram.

expected.defect: the evaluation pipeline still contains RandomResizedCrop and RandomHorizontalFlip
expected.why: every validation pass scores a different crop of every image, so the curve moves for reasons unrelated to the model and the score is systematically pessimistic

expected.defect: the device is named outright and nothing in the workspace calls torch.cuda.is_available()
expected.why: the script raises on the first tensor move on any machine without a GPU, which is every CI runner

expected.defect: a GradScaler is created and then bypassed - the backward is not wrapped in scaler.scale(...)
expected.why: half-precision gradients underflow to zero, so whole layers stop learning while the loss curve still looks plausible

expected.defect: the clip runs after the optimizer step, in the same block
expected.why: the exploding update it was meant to prevent has already landed on the weights

expected.defect: CosineAnnealingLR is an epoch schedule, stepped once per batch
expected.why: the cosine reaches its floor inside the first epoch, so 39 of the 40 epochs train at the minimum learning rate

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled rather than its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint stores the class path, so it stops loading the day the module is renamed or moved

expected.defect: an hourly series with lag features is shuffled into a random train/test split
expected.why: each test row sits between two training rows an hour either side of it, so the reported error is an interpolation score rather than a forecast score

expected.defect: accuracy_score is handed the probability matrix from predict_proba
expected.why: it compares floats with integer labels, so the accuracy reported is roughly the chance rate whatever the model does - and it is a number, not an error

expected.defect: roc_auc_score is fed the hard 0/1 output of predict()
expected.why: the ROC curve collapses to two points, so the number is balanced accuracy wearing an AUC label

forbidden.why: the training DataLoader is built with shuffle=True
the evaluation DataLoader keeps dataset order with shuffle=False
neither loader sets num_workers, and both are built inside build_loaders() rather than at import time
there is no tf.data pipeline in this project at all
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is the first statement of every training step
the backward at line 57 precedes scaler.step(optimizer) at line 58 - the order of those two is correct
both the model and every batch are moved to the same device
torch.manual_seed(SEED) at line 39, and the split and the estimator both take random_state=SEED
nothing is fitted before the split: the frame is built from lags only and the estimator is fitted on the training half
there is no Keras model in this project
there is no LightningModule here; the loop is hand-written on purpose and owns its own gradients
same - no Lightning hook exists to return a loss from
there is no HuggingFace Trainer in this project
the scheduler is stepped by hand in a plain torch loop, so no Lightning interval applies - MLV207 is the rule that judges that cadence
